pages.text: $(bold)Nyarlathotep's Desire$()$(br2)Obtaining: within $(bold)5 seconds$() of attacking a villager, make it die by $(bold)something other than a player$() (falling / drowning / other mobs); $(bold)10 seconds later$(), a $(bold)50%$() chance to obtain it — otherwise you are punished with $(bold)Wither II for 60 seconds$().$(br2)Twisted desire is born from the unnatural death of a villager.
